items.front: Bifurcation — appointed day, assent, asset-split ratio.
items.back: AP Reorganisation Act 2014 (Act 6 of 2014): assent 1 Mar 2014, appointed day 2 Jun 2014. Assets/liabilities split mainly on population ratio 58.32 : 41.68 (AP : Telangana).
items.examPoint: Bifurcation, Loss of Hyderabad & the New Capital Amaravati

items.front: Why did bifurcation cause AP's fiscal stress?
items.back: Hyderabad (united state's biggest revenue/IT/services engine) went to Telangana as common capital (≤10 yrs); residuary AP lost a mature revenue base AND had to fund a new capital → revenue deficit.
items.examPoint: Bifurcation, Loss of Hyderabad & the New Capital Amaravati

items.front: Amaravati — location, how the land was assembled.
items.back: Greenfield capital on Krishna's right bank, Guntur dist. (near Vijayawada); land via Land Pooling Scheme (LPS) from farmers; governed by APCRDA; ~217 km². Reaffirmed sole capital; WB/ADB funding 2024.
items.examPoint: Bifurcation, Loss of Hyderabad & the New Capital Amaravati

items.front: AP macro — GSDP size, sector shares.
items.back: GSDP 2026-27 ~₹19.75 lakh cr (rank ~8th-9th). Shares (GSVA 2023-24): agriculture ~37%, industry ~23%, services ~40%. More agrarian than India (~18% farm) but services largest.
items.examPoint: Macro Snapshot — GSDP, Growth, Per-capita & Sector Shares

items.front: Primary sector — 'Rice Bowl' and AP's #1 rank.
items.back: 'Rice Bowl of India' = Krishna & Godavari deltas. AP leads Indian aquaculture (farmed shrimp/inland fish exports); agriculture supports ~60% of people; Guntur chillies lead horticulture.
items.examPoint: Primary-sector Strength — Rice Bowl, Aquaculture & Horticulture

items.back: On the Godavari (Eluru dist.); National Project under Sec 90 (Centre executes, Telangana consent deemed given). ~23 lakh acres irrigation, 960 MW hydel (12×80 MW), drinking water; ~194 tmcft.
items.examPoint: Water Resources, River Boards & the Polavaram National Project

items.front: River boards — which HQ is where?
items.back: Krishna River Management Board (KRMB) HQ in AP; Godavari River Management Board (GRMB) HQ in Telangana; both under an Apex Council chaired by the Union Jal Shakti Minister.
items.examPoint: Water Resources, River Boards & the Polavaram National Project

items.front: VCIC — what is it and who backs it?
items.back: Visakhapatnam-Chennai Industrial Corridor = first phase of East Coast Economic Corridor (ECEC), India's first coastal corridor, ADB-supported. Nodes: Vizag, Machilipatnam, Donakonda, Chittoor.
items.examPoint: Industry, Ports, Visakhapatnam & the VCIC Corridor

items.back: India's 2nd-longest coastline ~974 km (after Gujarat). Vizag = only major (central) port; non-major: Krishnapatnam, Gangavaram, Kakinada, Machilipatnam. New greenfield: Ramayapatnam, Mulapeta.
items.examPoint: Industry, Ports, Visakhapatnam & the VCIC Corridor

items.back: AP's developed-state vision aligned with Viksit Bharat@2047 via a Public-Private-People (P4) approach. Coastal Andhra developed; Rayalaseema & Uttarandhra lag — special package (Sec 46).
items.examPoint: Swarna Andhra Vision@2047, Regional Disparities, Districts & e-Governance

items.front: AP districts count evolution & SCS status.
items.back: Districts: 13 → 26 (4 Apr 2022) → 28 (from 31 Dec 2025, adding Polavaram & Markapuram). Special Category Status was a Rajya Sabha assurance (Feb 2014), NOT in the Act; Special Package offered instead.
items.examPoint: Swarna Andhra Vision@2047, Regional Disparities, Districts & e-Governance

items.front: AP Budget 2026-27 headline size & top allocations.
items.back: Total expenditure ₹3,32,205 cr; fiscal deficit 3.84% GSDP, revenue deficit 1.11%. Highest dept School Education ₹32,308 cr; NTR Bharosa pensions ₹27,719 cr; Polavaram ₹6,105 cr; Amaravati ₹6,000 cr.
items.examPoint: Macro Snapshot — GSDP, Growth, Per-capita & Sector Shares

items.back: Google/Adani AI data hub Vizag (~$15bn, 1 GW — India's largest single FDI); ArcelorMittal-Nippon steel Nakkapalli; NTPC green-H2 Pudimadaka; Bhogapuram Airport & South Coast Railway zone live 2026.

items.front: General economy concepts tested in AP papers.
items.back: Lorenz Curve = income-inequality measure; Bombay Plan (1944) by industrialists; LPG (1991) = Liberalisation-Privatisation-Globalisation; FDI banned in chit funds, lottery, gambling, atomic energy.
items.examPoint: Macro Snapshot — GSDP, Growth, Per-capita & Sector Shares
